supported_types.description: An optional list of supported authorization types. More than one can be supported and tried in sequence. Defaults to `None` if empty or missing.

passport_auth_issuers.description: If authorizations contain `PassportAuth`, this is a required list of visa issuers that may authorize access to this object.

bearer_auth_issuers.description: If authorizations contain `BearerAuth`, this is an optional list of issuers that may authorize access to this object.
